Boundaries representing Secondary Planning Areas, related to the land use policies contained in the Brampton Official Plan, Schedule G.

Major updates to boundaries were updated as part of the 2025 Office Consolidation.

Secondary plans contain policies and mapping for districts identified within an Official Plan as requiring more detailed direction on land use, community design, natural heritage and transportation. They provide a framework for the development of new communities and employment zones or defined smaller areas like a downtown or an existing built-up area of the City.

 
Updated: May 4,  2026
